issue_request: FHIR-50224 is an Applied/Persuasive OO technical correction for FHIR-core-ServiceRequest. It asked to fix the ServiceRequest.orderDetail definition typo from "For example, and order for a urinary catheter" to "For example, an order for a urinary catheter" on the ServiceRequest definitions page, applied for R6.
initial_application: No prior reconciliation commit with Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-50224 was present on the combined branch. The active ServiceRequest.orderDetail source had already been corrected by the FHIR-31589 ServiceRequest clarification work in 2024. A later git commit and merge mentioning FHIR-50224 exist in the current branch history, but they changed only publish.ini to add transport-resource-event.png and did not alter ServiceRequest wording.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The only remaining literal typo matches are in a commented-out legacy ServiceRequest.orderDetail XML block and in source/servicerequest/servicerequest.svg, a generated-looking diagram artifact. The authoritative active StructureDefinition element already uses the corrected definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing the inactive commented block or stale SVG would not improve the current specification semantics and would violate the run guardrail against source-changing commits whose only remaining target is generated-looking diagram output.
